name: layout-regression
description: The marketing site's homepage looks broken — the navigation bar is overlapping the headline at the top of the page, so the first thing visitors see is covered up. Fix the layout.
bugs: the navbar is position:fixed (60px tall) but .content has margin-top: 0, so the content (including the headline) renders underneath the navbar instead of below it
correct_diagnosis: The navbar is position:fixed and 60px tall, but .content had margin-top: 0, so the content rendered behind the navbar; offsetting the content by the navbar height (margin-top: 60px) makes the headline clear it.

reference_fix.description: Offset the content below the 60px fixed navbar.
